name: Deep Space Instruments
description: An instrument panel under an observatory dome: deep blue-black background, two glows in cyan and indigo, an 80px grid, cyan anchor labels, 800-weight negative-tracking headings, keywords set in cyan serif italic. Monospace furniture.

ink.use: primary text; background of inverted pages

accent.use: the only accent: anchors, kicker, key numbers, nodes, CTA, em

accent2.use: cool violet of the second glow and card backgrounds; never on text

display.family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

body.family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
